front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《47》

zh: 歷史的碎片，歲月的孤寂
en: Because of Pompeii, I see
Fragments of history, the loneliness of the years
The wordless joy and sorrow of causes arising and fading
The tangled affairs of the mortal world
Climbing over the fence of years
Where is the mood for gathering chrysanthemums

points.zh:
結廬在人境，而無車馬喧。
問君何能爾，心遠地自偏。
採菊東籬下，悠然見南山。
山氣日夕佳，飛鳥相與還。
--晉。陶淵明《飲酒 · 其五》
points.en:
I built my hut amid the world of men, yet there is no noise of carriages or horses.
You ask how this can be — when the heart is far, the place itself becomes remote.
I pick chrysanthemums under the eastern hedge, and in the distance calmly see the southern mountain.
The mountain air is beautiful at dusk, as birds fly home together in flocks.
-- Jin dynasty. Tao Yuanming, 'Drinking Wine, No. 5'

en: In winter, the moon rises
Clinging to withered branches at the corner of the roof
Reflecting a snowy night, soundless
The wind asks the ripples on the sea's surface
What is your metaphysics?
Dancing with the light

flow.caption_zh: 土耳其海邊午后景象。  On the way from Mersin to Antalya.
丹麥哥本哈根港外風力發電站的晨景。攝於遊輪上。

zh: 丹麥的人均風力發電，世界第一；全球第一個離岸風場，丹麥人蓋的。丹麥目前陸上的風電成本，已經比任何一種發電型式都低。「丹麥模式」成為全球新能源的典範。風能，已經和童話、自行車一樣，逐漸成為這個維京王國的代名詞。
en: Denmark's per-capita wind power generation ranks first in the world; the world's first offshore wind farm was built by the Danish. Denmark's current cost of onshore wind power generation is already lower than any other form of power generation. The "Danish model" has become the global exemplar of new energy. Wind power, like fairy tales and bicycles, has gradually become synonymous with this Viking kingdom.
At dawn, cutting off
The most radiant rose
Is spring still here?
The Pacific, rolling in and rolling out again
Rolling up rippling spray, following the starlight
Returning to a homeland with a sandy shore

points.zh:
楊牧 《 瓶中稿 》
這時日落的方向是西
越過眼前的柏樹，潮水
此岸，但知每一片波浪
都從花蓮開始，那時
也曾驚問過遠方
不知有沒有一個海岸？
如今那彼岸此岸，惟有
飄零的星光
如今也惟有一片星光
照我疲倦的傷感
細問洶湧而來的波浪
可懷念花蓮的沙灘？
points.en:
Yang Mu, 'Manuscript in a Bottle'
At this hour the direction of the sunset is west,
beyond the cypress trees before my eyes, the tide —
on this shore, I only know each wave
begins from Hualien; back then
I too once asked, wondering, of that far place,
whether there was a shore at all?
Now, whether that shore or this,
there is only scattered starlight,
now there is only a stretch of starlight
shining on my weary sorrow,
asking gently of the surging waves that come —
do you still remember the sands of Hualien?

en: Opening The Arabian Nights
Then there is a magic carpet, to carry you home
Childhood's wonder

zh: 斜照查理大橋，水色浮蕩
en: That year, the sunset over Prague
Slanting light on Charles Bridge, the water's color rippling
Klimt's opulent desire

points.zh: 古斯塔夫．克林姆 ( Gustav Klimt ) 1862年出生於維也納。是奧地利知名象徵主義畫家。他創辦了維也納分離派，是維也納文化圈代表人物。其畫作特色在於特殊的象徵式裝飾花紋，並在畫作中大量使用性愛主題。喜歡他畫作的人稱讚有其「沉悶美感」與大膽象徵寓意，但是卻也招致不少保守派畫家的負面評價。克林姆畫作另一特色為畫中主角大部分都是女人，主題則為「愛」、「性」、「生」與「死」的輪迴宿命。

zh: 這幅畫可以說是克林姆繪畫生涯的最高峰。畫中裹在金色衣飾裡的男子和女子，在花朵盛開的懸崖邊緊緊擁抱。男子接吻的力度似乎可以感受得到。女子神態嫵媚，緊閉雙眼，右手緊握成拳，說不清是抗拒還是迎合。克林姆的畫家之譽，不僅僅來自於他以真黃金作畫，更是因為他在這系列作品中，將抽象和寫實完美地融合在一起。人物的形態是真實的，身上衣物的裝飾是虚幻的幾何圖形。        (奧地利維也納國家美術畫廊)
en: This painting may be called the pinnacle of Klimt's career. A man and woman, wrapped in golden robes, embrace tightly at the edge of a blossoming cliff. One can almost feel the intensity of the man's kiss. The woman's expression is alluring, her eyes shut tight, her right hand clenched into a fist—it is unclear whether she resists or yields. Klimt's fame as a painter comes not only from his use of real gold, but from how, in this series, he fused the abstract and the realistic to perfection. The figures' forms are true to life, while the ornamentation of their garments dissolves into illusory geometric patterns. (Austrian Gallery, Belvedere, Vienna)

flow.caption_zh: 《艾蒂兒畫像 一 Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I》  1907.

zh: 這幅曾被譽為「奧地利的蒙娜麗莎」的知名畫作，是以瀝粉、貼金箔等特殊手法創作出來。描繪了 19 世紀維也納的一個知名的女主人艾蒂兒，她是奧地利制糖業富商斐迪南．布洛赫．鮑爾的妻子。畫作中，艾蒂兒身穿一件黃金衣服，儀態優雅、眼神迷離，雙手交叉放在胸前，掩飾一隻殘疾的手指。   (美國紐約新藝畫廊   Neue Galerie New York)
en: This famous painting, once hailed as the "Mona Lisa of Austria," was created using special techniques such as raised gesso and gold leaf. It depicts a well-known Vienna society hostess of the 19th century, Adele, wife of Ferdinand Bloch-Bauer, an Austrian sugar magnate. In the painting, Adele wears a golden gown, her bearing elegant and her gaze distant, her hands crossed over her chest to conceal an injured finger. (Neue Galerie New York)
The sacred tree said, let the wind blow
Wind upon wind, rain upon rain
My roots dig deep into the earth
If, where the starlight falls
There is also the homeland—has it ever
Asking again, when shall we set out?

points.zh:
《 念故鄉，Going Home 》
曲︰德弗札克    詞︰李抱忱
念故鄉，念故鄉，故鄉真可愛，
天甚清，風甚涼，鄉愁陣陣來。
故鄉人，今如何，常念念不忘，
在他鄉，一孤客，寂寞又淒涼。
我願意，回故鄉，重返舊家園，
眾親友，聚一堂，同享從前樂。
這首《念故鄉， Going Home 》的旋律是來自捷克音樂家德弗札克 ( Antonin Leopold Dvorak,  1841-1904 ) 的《 第九交響曲 》( 又名《新世界交響曲》) 第二樂章緩板。這是德弗札克在1893年完成的作品， 當時他應邀到美國出任紐約國家音樂學院院長。這樂章依稀有美國南方黑人靈歌的旋律。1969年，人類首次登陸月球時，太空人阿姆斯壯 ( Neil Armstrong ) 帶上的就有《 新世界交響曲 》的錄音。
points.en:
"Longing for Home, Going Home"
Music: Antonin Dvorak; Lyrics: Li Bao-chen
I long for home, I long for home, my home is truly dear,
the sky so clear, the wind so cool, homesickness comes wave after wave.
The people back home, how are they now? I think of them constantly,
here in this foreign land, a lone traveler, lonely and desolate.
I wish to return home, to return to my old home,
to gather again with relatives and friends, to share the joys of the past.
The melody of "Longing for Home, Going Home" comes from the Largo, the second movement of the "Ninth Symphony" (also known as the "New World Symphony") by the Czech composer Antonin Leopold Dvorak (1841-1904). Dvorak completed this work in 1893, while serving as director of the National Conservatory of Music in New York at the invitation of the United States. The movement faintly echoes the melodies of African American spirituals from the American South. In 1969, when humans first landed on the moon, astronaut Neil Armstrong carried with him a recording of the "New World Symphony."
